nodes.description: Mapping of reflection balances used as the primary accounting store for all holders.
Nested mapping of ERC20 allowances owner=>spender=>amount.
Mapping flagging addresses exempt from transfer fees.
Mapping flagging blacklisted bot addresses blocked from transferring.
Mapping storing per-address last-buy timestamps used for the cooldown mechanism.
Total reflections supply, reduced on every fee reflection.
Maximum transaction amount enforced on buys while cooldown is enabled.
Stored Uniswap V2 router instance used for swaps and liquidity.
Stored address of the FINJA/WETH Uniswap pair.
Flag enabling the automatic contract-token swap-and-send path.
Reentrancy-style guard flag set while a swap is in progress.
Payable marketing/fee wallet that receives half of collected ETH and controls manual functions.
Core internal transfer routine applying bot checks, cooldown, max-tx limit and the automatic swap/send of accumulated fees.
Public ERC20 transfer entrypoint delegating to _transfer with the caller as sender.
Public ERC20 transferFrom delegating to _transfer and decreasing allowance.
Swaps contract-held tokens for ETH through the router, guarded by lockTheSwap, using a user-influenced timestamp deadline.
Splits contract ETH balance in half and sends it to the two fee wallets via raw transfers.
Owner-only function that wires up the router/pair, adds liquidity with the contract ETH balance and enables trading, swap and cooldown.
Wallet-1-only function that swaps the entire contract token balance for ETH.
Wallet-1-only function that forwards the whole contract ETH balance to the fee wallets.
Internal allowance setter writing _allowances and emitting Approval.
Applies reflection/token balance updates for a transfer and triggers team fee and reflection accounting.
Computes transfer, fee and team amounts in both token and reflection space using the current rate.
Owner-only function that blacklists an array of addresses.
Owner-only setter for buy-side marketing and redistribution fee parameters.
Owner-only setter for sell-side marketing and redistribution fee parameters.
Owner-only toggle for the cooldown restriction.
Deploys token: assigns fee wallets, mints all reflections to the deployer and pre-exempts addresses from fees.
Moves the team fee portion of reflections into the contract's own balance.
Reduces _rTotal by the reflection fee and increases cumulative _tFeeTotal.
Returns the current owner address stored in Ownable.
Derives the reflection rate as rSupply/tSupply.
Caller-controlled address used for transfers, approvals, ownership checks and manual function authorization.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for the cooldown gate and as the swap/liquidity deadline.
External call to the router swapping tokens for ETH with amountOutMin=0 and recipient set to the contract.
Raw ETH transfer to the fee wallet performed after state changes in the swap path.
External payable router call that adds liquidity using the entire contract ETH balance with zero minimums.
Fee/team percentage arithmetic (mul/div/sub) whose inputs are owner-settable fee parameters.
Sender address parameter of _transfer, used for bot, pair, exemption and ownership checks.
Recipient address parameter of _transfer, used for bot, pair and exemption checks.
Transfer amount parameter of _transfer checked against _maxTxAmount.
Local snapshot of the contract's token balance that is swapped for ETH inside _transfer.
Local snapshot of the contract ETH balance forwarded to the fee wallets.
Local reflection rate used to convert token amounts into reflection amounts.
Array parameter of setBots listing addresses to blacklist.
Amount parameter of swapTokensForEth approved to and swapped by the router.

edges.reason: transfer() delegates all logic to _transfer with the caller as sender.
transferFrom() delegates to _transfer then reduces the allowance.
msg.sender supplies the from address of a transfer via _msgSender().
block.timestamp gates the per-recipient buy cooldown; a miner can manipulate the check.
Timestamp is written into the cooldown mapping, making the restriction miner-influenced.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth (external router call) while executing transfer accounting.
swapTokensForEth forwards the token amount into the external router swap call.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
_transfer reaches sendETHToFee, which performs external ETH transfers, after internal accounting.
The halved ETH amount flows into a low-level transfer to the fee wallet.
_transferStandard subtracts/credits reflection balances in _rOwned.
_takeTeam credits the contract's reflection balance in _rOwned.
_reflectFee reduces the total reflections supply _rTotal.
openTrading stores the hardcoded router address into uniswapV2Router.
openTrading creates and stores the Uniswap pair address.
openTrading forwards the contract ETH balance into the external addLiquidityETH router call with zero minimums.
manualswap triggers the external swap path on the entire contract token balance.
manualsend triggers external ETH transfers of the whole contract balance.
manualswap authorization relies solely on comparing msg.sender to _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorization relies solely on comparing msg.sender to _feeAddrWallet1.
_transfer exempts the owner address from bot/cooldown/fee restrictions via owner().
setBots writes blacklist flags into the bots mapping.
setCooldownEnabled toggles the flag that activates the cooldown mapping checks.
_transfer reads the inSwap guard before entering the external swap path.
_transfer checks swapEnabled to decide whether to auto-swap accumulated tokens.
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount, an owner-controllable transfer limit.
_transfer reads bots[from]/bots[to] to block blacklisted addresses.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to bypass cooldown and fee logic for privileged addresses.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair to detect buys and sells.
_transfer computes the contract token balance into the local variable.
The contract token balance is passed to swapTokensForEth and consumed by the external swap.
The contract ETH balance is passed to sendETHToFee for external payout.
_transfer finalizes accounting by calling _tokenTransfer/_transferStandard.
_transferStandard obtains all amounts from _getValues.
_getValues derives the current reflection rate via _getRate.
The computed reflection rate is used to scale token amounts into reflection amounts.
The from parameter drives the sender-side checks and balance updates.
The recipient parameter drives the receiver-side checks and balance credits.
The amount parameter is validated and passed into token accounting.
The bots_ array is iterated to populate blacklist flags.
The tokenAmount parameter is approved and forwarded to the external router swap.
The from parameter indexes bots[] to reject blacklisted senders.
swapTokensForEth reads the stored router to build the swap path and perform the swap.
sendETHToFee pays half the ETH balance to the fee wallet 1 address.
_approve writes the spender allowance into _allowances.
openTrading calls _approve to grant the router token allowance.
The constructor mints the full reflection supply into _rOwned of the deployer.
The deployer address (msg.sender) becomes owner and initial holder in the constructor.
The external router swap can re-enter the transfer flow through the payable receive() and swap paths.
_getValues computes fee/team percentages through multiplication and division that depend on owner-settable fee parameters.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to feed _transfer's sender checks and balance updates, so it collapses into that function.
The recipient parameter is only consumed by _transfer's receiver checks and balance credits.
The amount parameter is fully consumed by _transfer's max-tx validation and token accounting.
This local only caches the contract balance computed inside _transfer before the swap call.
This local only carries the contract ETH balance into sendETHToFee for payout.
This local only holds the reflection rate used to scale amounts during standard transfer accounting.
The bots_ array exists solely as the input list iterated by setBots.
The tokenAmount parameter is only approved and forwarded into the router swap inside swapTokensForEth.
